plugins.description: Ad creative — generate finished static ads (4:5 feed + 9:16 stories) for any brand in your Great Ads AI workspace. The skill writes one on-brand angle + headline, you pick a style, and Great Ads AI renders + saves a Ready-For-Review card. Runs entirely on the Great Ads AI hosted API (our image models, billed to your credits) — you only need one Great Ads API key.
